subject: Lane A claims GPU for non-mutating Qwen3.5 causal-conv parity
body: Adjacent non-mutating runtime research only. Test exact Qwen3.5 conv geometry B=1,T in {128,512},D=8192,W=4, bf16, silu: Transformers torch reference causal_conv1d_fn versus already-installed FLA 0.5.2 Triton causal_conv1d. Measure forward max/mean error, input-gradient cosine/relative-L2/max error, and warmed forward+backward timing. No model weights, optimizer, adapter, branch subject, or Lane-B worktree will be mutated. This directly tests whether we can remove the reference causal-conv bottleneck without installing/compiling causal-conv1d. Lane B should remain CPU-only until release.
